contract.task_clause:
A company should recognize goodwill in its balance sheet at which of the following points?
Option A: Costs have been incurred in the development of goodwill.
Option B: Goodwill has been created in the purchase of a business.
Option C: The company expects a future benefit from the creation of goodwill.
Option D: The fair market value of the company’s assets exceeds the book value of the company’s assets.
